ancestors.title: Phase 2 - Customer liability automatic creation action (2)

storage.value:
Liability object field

Field filling logic

example

Number

Should be generated automatically by the system with the following structure:

  • Liability-ID of newly created liability

  1. (For example, Liability-56)

    1. In the given example, Liability is hardcoded prefix for number and 56 is ID of liability

Accounting period

Should be taken from invoice object from which this liability was generated

Creation date

Date of liability creation

Due date

Should be taken from invoice according to the 'Payment deadline' field

Date of full offset

Should be filled by the system according of the offsetting process

Applicable interest rate

empty

Interest rate applicable date from

empty

Interest rate applicable date to

empty

Initial amount

Should be taken from according to the 'Total amount including VAT' field form the invoice

Initial amount in other currency

Should be taken from according to the 'Total amount including VAT in other currency' field form the invoice

Current amount

Should be taken from according to the 'Total amount including VAT' field form the invoice

  • When liability is created automatically, in this case Current amount including VAT and Initial invoice amount including VAT values should be equal to each other (after offsetting process can be changed this value)

Current amount in other currency

Should be taken from according to the 'Total amount including VAT in other currency' field form the invoice

  • When liability is created automatically, in this case Current amount including VAT and Initial invoice amount including VAT values should be equal to each other (after offsetting process can be changed this value)

Currency

Should be taken from 'Currency' field from the invoice (from Basic Data tab)

Outgoing document from an external system

Should be taken from invoice - invoice number value

Number of income account

should be taken from "taxes for the grid operator" nomenclature

Cost center / Controlling order

should be taken from "taxes for the grid operator" nomenclature

Basis for issuing

Should be displayed according to the 'Basis for issuing' field from the invoice

Direct Debit checkbox (bank, BIV, bank account)

should be taken from invoice (from Basic Data tab)

Additional liability information

empty

Blocked for payment checkbox

empty

Blocked for reminder letters checkbox

empty

Blocked for calculation of late payment fines/interests checkbox

empty

Blocked for liabilities offsetting checkbox

empty

Blocked for supply termination checkbox

empty

Customer

Should be taken from according to the 'Customer' sub-object from invoice

Billing group

Should be taken from according to the 'Billing group ' sub-object from invoice

Alternative recipient of an invoice

Should be taken from according to the 'Recipient of an invoice ' sub-object from invoice

Payment and liabilities offsetting

Should be empty on liability creation (after offsetting will be filled

  • Customer liability should not be generated with amount zero

Customer feedbacks

https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2474
